title: The Packet of Sunflower Seeds
youtube_title: The Packet of Sunflower Seeds | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Quinn sees that a packet of sunflower seeds, half still folded shut will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Quinn makes a smaller, even share so Jaleh is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
